blocks.title: Zo gebruik je deze lijsten
bullets: Leer de woorden met hun vaste voorzetsel en een voorbeeldzin.
Dek één kolom af en overhoor jezelf in beide richtingen.
Deze woorden komen veel voor in het examen C1 Advanced van Cambridge.

blocks.title: evidence is ontelbaar
blocks.text: evidence heeft geen meervoud: There is a lot of evidence, niet evidences. Voor één bewijsstuk: a piece of evidence.

blocks.text: In het examen C1 Advanced (en in academisch schrijven) moet je dezelfde betekenis met andere woorden kunnen uitdrukken.

head: Origineel
Parafrase
rows: It's possible that he will resign.
She was not able to finish.
He is said to be very rich.
I wish I had studied harder.
The meeting was cancelled because of the strike.
The strike led to the cancellation of the meeting.

blocks.text: Vul het ontbrekende woord in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: There is no ______ that the drug works.
items.full: There is no evidence that the drug works.

items.q: We need a new ______ to the problem.
items.full: We need a new approach to the problem.

items.q: The report ______ the need for more funding.
items.full: The report highlights the need for more funding.

items.q: Social media has had a huge ______ on politics.
items.full: Social media has had a huge impact on politics.

items.q: She was very ______ when I told her about my problems.
items.full: She was very sympathetic when I told her about my problems.

items.q: I didn't ______ how late it was.
items.full: I didn't realise how late it was.

items.q: He ______ that he had made a mistake.
items.full: He acknowledged that he had made a mistake.

items.q: Climate change is a serious ______ to wildlife.
items.full: Climate change is a serious threat to wildlife.

items.q: He is said ______ be very rich.
items.full: He is said to be very rich.

items.a: There is a lot of evidence.
We need to tackle this problem.

items.q: Ik besefte niet hoe laat het was.
items.a: I didn't realise how late it was.
